world_container_throughput_teu.note: World port container throughput in 2024; UNCTAD page updated 2026-04-15. Port throughput counts handling, not unique cargo voyages.

teu_per_primary_move.note: Assumed mix of container lengths; throughput conversion, not a physical constant.

electric_quay_total_kwh_per_move.note: Dated example at 30 moves/hour, including auxiliary load; not a universal cycle measurement.

electric_quay_auxiliary_kwh_per_move.note: Auxiliary energy allocated per move in the same dated example; not all of it disappears with one avoided lift.

thai_grid_kgco2e_per_kwh.note: TGO April 2026 grid factor; apply only to a comparable Thai electric-quay cycle, not mixed/global rehandles.

pilot_min_capacity_teu.note: v6 design envelope, not a measured result.

pilot_max_capacity_teu.note: v6 design envelope, not a measured result.

pilot_max_boxes.note: v6 design envelope, not TEU capacity.

pilot_max_fill.note: v6 design envelope; empty arrival, one loading call.

laem_chabang_container_calls_per_year.note: BSAA 2024 activity: all container-vessel sizes, not eligible feeder or pilot calls.

terminal_revenue_low_usd.note: 360iResearch 2024 container-terminal-operator market estimate, verified on GII's full reseller listing dated28Aug2025; not stated on the current publisher page. Commercial estimate, not audited global receipts.

terminal_revenue_mid_usd.note: TechSci 2024 container-terminal operations estimate, directly verified on its June2025 release. Scope includes storage/intermodal services and cargo categories broader than containers; not audited global receipts or an interpolated midpoint.

terminal_revenue_high_usd.note: Upper verified benchmark repeats TechSci2024 estimate. Unverified IBISWorld figure excluded, not carried as an assumed upper bound. This is a commercial-estimate comparison range, not three independent market measurements.

primary_moves_per_call.note: Hypothetical primary productive load lifts, one container per lift; no transfer of old section-level results.

extra_rehandles_per_primary_move.note: Assumed attributable extra lifts, not a measured local rate or share of all moves.

rehandle_reduction.note: Hypothetical effect, independent of legacy selected-lift results; may fail to transfer.

yard_extra_rehandles_per_relevant_primar.note: Worldwide transfer ASSUMPTION: Legato/Mazza WSC2013 Table 2 simulated reshuffles for real loading plans; ratios 23.67/633, 33.24/360, 18/84. Selected case sensitivity, not a global observed distribution.

yard_eligible_throughput_fraction.note: Assumed loaded-export/retrieval-relevant throughput; avoids applying the yard ratio to all port throughput.

ship_extra_lift_charge_usd.note: Assumed price sensitivity discounted from regional list-tariff context: SAGT USD46.50-80/lift; Yusen LA USD205.93 cell shift; Liverpool GBP192.92/lift. Not a weighted world price or marginal operating cost.

yard_extra_lift_charge_usd.note: Assumed sensitivity using Ries USD10/rehandle cost context and regional charge context: SAGT sorting USD25-47/container, Yusen mounting/grounding USD99.41, Liverpool GBP57.03/additional yard lift. Different service bundles; not a measured global marginal cost.

global_container_calls_per_year.note: Rounded computed 2 x approximately260000 calls/half-year. UNCTAD RMT2025 ch4 says 2024 halves stayed near H2 2023; AIS/IMO >=1000GT coverage, not exact all-vessel census.

berth_hours_per_call.note: Assumed global port hours20/35/60 x CPPI75% berth share. CPPI Table5.1 call-size means are context, not a fleet mean; excludes anchorage in the resulting berth hours.

charter_usd_per_day.note: Assumed world fleet proxies selected from VHBS29Oct2026 twelve-month assessments for1100/2500/6500TEU. Sourced assessments, unmeasured world mix. Charter opportunity value excludes separate fuel dollars.

reducible_berth_share.note: Assume removing modeled extra work shortens berth stay2/5/10%; critical-path and parallel-crane effect, not a measured elasticity. Ship-time opportunity only, with no separate fuel charge.

carrier_planner_hours_per_call.note: Assumed global transfer of published2-3h whole-port allocation effort; midpoint2.5h. Full workflow-effort pool before capture, not all waste or time already saved.

carrier_planner_usd_per_hour.note: Assumed global opportunity-cost spread; BLS May2025 US logisticians medianUSD82320/year /2080h =39.58 rounded is context, not a global port-planner wage. Carrier planning excludes terminal tariff labor.

capture_fraction.note: Assumed combined adoption, eligibility and realized improvement applied once to the gross opportunity; not the scale scenarios' throughput adoption.

marginal_electric_quay_kwh_per_extra_lif.note: Assumed worldwide transfer of dated PEMA total-minus-auxiliary example; not applicable to every crane or every restow.

marginal_yard_kwh_per_extra_lift.note: Unquantified: no comparable global marginal yard-energy evidence selected; zero emissions credit, not a claim yard lifts use zero energy.

electricity_kgco2_per_kwh.note: IEA Electricity2025 reports2024 world generation intensity445gCO2/kWh. Transfer to port electricity and marginal avoided generation is an assumption; operational CO2, not lifecycle CO2e.

container_ship_auxiliary_kw_at_berth.note: Assumed fleet mix using EPA2022 hotelling auxiliary-load defaults across container size categories; operating load already included. Excludes boiler, main engines and shore power.

berth_auxiliary_kgco2_per_kwh.note: EPA2022 MGO auxiliary217g fuel/kWh x3.206gCO2/gfuel. Assumed all relevant hotelling load burns this fuel; operational CO2 excludes lifecycle/nonCO2 effects.

low.label: projection
low.interpretation: Global annual gross opportunity pool before capture, not a result, revenue forecast or all avoidable cost. Alternative cases; do not add to pilot or scale outputs. Handling charges, ship-time and carrier labor are distinct opportunity-equivalent categories, not one party's profit. No fuel dollars are added.

emissions.label: projection
emissions.interpretation: Separate nonmonetized operational CO2 potential: extra ship lifts assumed electric and removable, plus assumed reducible berth hours. Yard energy unquantified by default. Not an inventory, lifecycle CO2e or achieved reduction; no emissions are monetized.

mid.label: projection
mid.interpretation: Global annual gross opportunity pool before capture, not a result, revenue forecast or all avoidable cost. Alternative cases; do not add to pilot or scale outputs. conditional_emissions.label: projection
conditional_emissions.assumption: Subtract allocated auxiliary energy to proxy marginal lift work. No berth-time or annual emissions estimate; do not apply to mixed/global rehandles.

exposure.label: projection
exposure.interpretation: Commercial terminal-revenue benchmarks plus full annual vessel time at berth, valued only with mid-case call, berth-hour and charter inputs. Exposure is a cost-context frame, not waste, savings, or an amount added to the prize. Terminal charges already include extra handling. No planner or fuel dollars are added.
exposure.headline_rounding_rule: Round the lower-end exposure total to the nearest ten billion USD. This is a rounded lower-end frame, not the middle benchmark, a saving, or a precisely measured total. One percent uses that rounded frame.

laem_chabang.label: projection
laem_chabang.note: Illustrative allocation from exact call share, with identical global inputs and average workload per call. Not eligible feeder demand or measured local saving; do not add to the world pool. Headline rounds to the nearest USD5M. Unavailable if world calls are zero or fewer than local calls.
